dedupe_keys.name: administration des ponts et chaussees road datasets

description: Administration des Ponts et Chaussées: road datasets is a collection of datasets listed in The Luxembourg Data Platform, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Administration des Ponts et Chaussées. Coverage: Administration des Ponts et Chaussées. The listing groups 10 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about road; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: PCH : Comptage du trafic sur le réseau routier national; PCH : Réseau routier numérique – Digitales Straßennetz; PCH : Comptage Trafic; Cita : Événements trafic en Datex-II v3.6. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is cc-zero. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-la-plateforme-de-donnees-luxembourgeoise.
